say:0:1523101001:0.text: It's unwise to confront them directly.

say:1:1523102001:0.text: I can't just ignore it either... I'm caught between a rock and a hard place!
say:1:1523102001:0.source_cn: 直接回应也不行，放着不管更不行……到底该怎么办？

choice_prompt:2:1523102001.text: I can't just ignore it either... I'm caught between a rock and a hard place!
choice_prompt:2:1523102001.source_cn: 直接回应也不行，放着不管更不行……到底该怎么办？

say:3:1523102002:1.text: <style="stress"><player_name></style>, you came at the perfect time! Halia needs your help!
say:3:1523102002:1.male: <style="stress"><player_name></style>, you came at the perfect time! Halia needs your help!
say:3:1523102002:1.female: <style="stress"><player_name></style>, you came at the perfect time! Halia needs your help!

say:4:1523102003:1.text: Remember the truce agreement I signed with Kordan? There's a clause stating that the Wildborn will manage the wheat seeds you donated and share the harvest with us.
say:4:1523102003:1.source_cn: 你还记得我和戈丹签署的停战合约吗？里面有一条条款写明了...
say:4:1523102003:1.male: Remember the truce agreement I signed with Kordan? There's a clause stating that the Wildborn will manage the wheat seeds you donated and share the harvest with us.
say:4:1523102003:1.female: Remember the truce agreement I signed with Kordan? There's a clause stating that the Wildborn will manage the wheat seeds you donated and share the harvest with us.

say:5:1523102004:0.text: The councilmen... they strongly opposed it and have been pressing me to revoke the agreement.
say:5:1523102004:0.source_cn: 其他议事官……对此很不满，一直在抗议，逼我撕毁合约。
say:5:1523102004:0.male: The councilmen... they strongly opposed it and have been pressing me to revoke the agreement.
say:5:1523102004:0.female: The councilmen... they strongly opposed it and have been pressing me to revoke the agreement.

say:6:1523102005:0.text: I held my ground, but they started staging demonstrations everywhere with their troops.
say:6:1523102005:0.source_cn: 我不同意，他们就带着士兵四处示威游行。
say:6:1523102005:0.male: I held my ground, but they started staging demonstrations everywhere with their troops.
say:6:1523102005:0.female: I held my ground, but they started staging demonstrations everywhere with their troops.

choice_prompt:7:1523102005.text: I held my ground, but they started staging demonstrations everywhere with their troops.
choice_prompt:7:1523102005.source_cn: 我不同意，他们就带着士兵四处示威游行。
choice_prompt:7:1523102005.male: I held my ground, but they started staging demonstrations everywhere with their troops.
choice_prompt:7:1523102005.female: I held my ground, but they started staging demonstrations everywhere with their troops.

say:9:1523102006:0.text: Not all, but a good number of them.

say:10:1523102007:1.text: ... With Perseus and Lygos both gone, their soldiers have been left leaderless.
say:10:1523102007:1.source_cn: ……珀尔修斯与隆尔在战场牺牲，他们麾下统领的士兵群龙无...

say:11:1523102008:1.text: Many of them couldn't accept their deaths, nor Halia's surrender. To make matters worse, the councilmen deliberately incited them to join the protests.
say:11:1523102008:1.source_cn: 很多士兵无法接受他们的离世，更无法接受呼临的投降。议事...

say:12:1523102009:1.text: Now that Halia is still recovering from the war, it can't endure another turmoil... As the Regulus, I must intervene.
say:12:1523102009:1.source_cn: 战争好不容易才结束，呼临城还没有完全恢复，现在又出现这...
say:12:1523102009:1.male: Now that Halia is still recovering from the war, it can't endure another turmoil... As the Regulus, I must intervene.
say:12:1523102009:1.female: Now that Halia is still recovering from the war, it can't endure another turmoil... As the Regulus, I must intervene.

say:13:1523102010:1.text: The thing is, Master Bakis and I haven't worked out what to do yet...
say:13:1523102010:1.source_cn: 不过，我和比博老师还没有商量好该怎么办……
say:13:1523102010:1.male: The thing is, Master Bakis and I haven't worked out what to do yet...
say:13:1523102010:1.female: The thing is, Master Bakis and I haven't worked out what to do yet...

say:14:1523102011:1.text: In any case, now isn't the time for a direct confrontation.
say:14:1523102011:1.source_cn: 无论如何，此时尚不可正面回应。

say:15:1523102012:1.text: Right now, what matters most to Halians is staying alive and having enough food.
say:15:1523102012:1.source_cn: 于呼临的民众而言，生存和食物才是第一要紧的事。

say:16:1523102013:1.text: The protestors' propaganda may sound motivating, yet it hardly resonates. After all, nobody wants to stay hungry or see their loved ones die.
say:16:1523102013:1.source_cn: 抗议口号听起来响亮，对他们的吸引力却很有限。谁也不想继...

say:17:1523102014:1.text: You should focus on addressing the unrest caused by the famine and war, Regulus.
say:17:1523102014:1.source_cn: 此时此刻，稳定人心，平息饥荒和战争带来的恐慌和不安，才...

say:18:1523102015:1.text: We may need your help with this, mage.
say:18:1523102015:1.source_cn: 这件事或许也要请你提供帮助，魔法师。
say:18:1523102015:1.male: We may need your help with this, mage.
say:18:1523102015:1.female: We may need your help with this, mage.

choice_prompt:19:1523102015.text: We may need your help with this, mage.
choice_prompt:19:1523102015.source_cn: 这件事或许也要请你提供帮助，魔法师。
choice_prompt:19:1523102015.male: We may need your help with this, mage.
choice_prompt:19:1523102015.female: We may need your help with this, mage.

say:20:1523102019:0.text: I offer you my sincere gratitude on behalf of Halia!
say:20:1523102019:0.source_cn: 作为呼临城的领主，我向你表达感谢！
say:20:1523102019:0.male: I offer you my sincere gratitude on behalf of Halia!
say:20:1523102019:0.female: I offer you my sincere gratitude on behalf of Halia!

say:22:1523102021:1.text: I'll speak with the protesting councilmen and aim to settle this without conflict.
say:22:1523102021:1.source_cn: 议事官们那边我会先去交涉，争取和平解决。

say:23:1523102022:1.text: Hopefully, peace will finally return to Halia.
say:23:1523102022:1.source_cn: 希望呼临城能早日恢复安宁。

say:25:1523102016:1.text: ... Ah, right. We haven't settled the scores with that guy who desecrated the corpses!
say:25:1523102016:1.source_cn: ……你提醒我了，呼临和那亵渎尸体之人的恩怨还没理清！
say:25:1523102016:1.male: ... Ah, right. We haven't settled the scores with that guy who desecrated the corpses!
say:25:1523102016:1.female: ... Ah, right. We haven't settled the scores with that guy who desecrated the corpses!

say:26:1523102017:1.text: I'll go after him as soon as things get under control!
say:26:1523102017:1.source_cn: 待局势稳定一些，我一定要和他算清这笔账！
say:26:1523102017:1.male: I'll go after him as soon as things get under control!
say:26:1523102017:1.female: I'll go after him as soon as things get under control!

choice_prompt:27:1523102017.text: I'll go after him as soon as things get under control!
choice_prompt:27:1523102017.source_cn: 待局势稳定一些，我一定要和他算清这笔账！
choice_prompt:27:1523102017.male: I'll go after him as soon as things get under control!
choice_prompt:27:1523102017.female: I'll go after him as soon as things get under control!

say:28:1523102018:1.text: Anyway, you'll help us, right? That's such a relief!
say:28:1523102018:1.source_cn: 总之你会帮呼临城的，对吧？那就太好了！
say:28:1523102018:1.male: Anyway, you'll help us, right? That's such a relief!
say:28:1523102018:1.female: Anyway, you'll help us, right? That's such a relief!

choice:19:1:2.text: Why don't you seek help from Merlin or Morgan?
choice:19:1:2.source_cn: 为什么不去找梅林和摩根呢？
choice:19:1:2.male: Why don't you seek help from Merlin or Morgan?
choice:19:1:2.female: Why don't you seek help from Merlin or Morgan?

choice:7:0:1.text: The soldiers follow their orders now?
choice:7:0:1.male: The soldiers follow their orders now?
choice:7:0:1.female: The soldiers follow their orders now?

choice:7:1:2.text: Who's calling the shots in the army now?
choice:7:1:2.source_cn: 现在士兵和军队归谁管？
choice:7:1:2.male: Who's calling the shots in the army now?
choice:7:1:2.female: Who's calling the shots in the army now?
